format_semantics: Metadata/code/docs compatibility decision only. Presence in upstream source is not execution qualification and grants no model/tokenizer access or training authority.
canonical_main_semantics: Exact canonical main from which the B009 branch was created. This is intentionally not the self-referential PR head SHA.

input_binding.interpretation: B005's embedded canonical_main_sha records B005 execution provenance. B009 consumes the exact B005 blob as committed in canonical main ead69ae; the two identities serve different provenance roles and are not drift.
input_binding.review_binding_rule: An exact-head review must identify the GitHub PR head externally and verify that this artifact blob is present at that head. Embedding the containing commit SHA inside this file would be self-referential and is not used as a validity rule.

status_vocabulary.SOURCE_REGISTERED: Pinned upstream source contains a model/family implementation or converter; no candidate artifact was executed.
status_vocabulary.GENERIC_PATH: Framework can operate on broad HF/causal-LM classes in principle; exact candidate compatibility was not executed.
status_vocabulary.UNVERIFIED: No sufficient direct evidence was established at the pinned source revision.
status_vocabulary.BLOCKED_RIGHTS_OR_IDENTITY: Compatibility cannot be canonicalized until rights or exact artifact identity is resolved.
status_vocabulary.NOT_EXECUTED: No artifact-backed runtime, training, conversion, export, or quantization claim.

source_evidence.interpretation: conversion/*.py proves converter-source presence only. src/models/smollm3.cpp is explicit runtime-source evidence for SmolLM3. No runtime implementation or fidelity claim is made for other families unless a runtime path is separately named. Unsloth/PEFT paths are family or framework evidence, not exact-candidate execution evidence.

global_findings: llama.cpp pinned source contains converter-source paths for Mellum, StarCoder2, StableLM/Stable Code, Falcon-H1, LFM2, BitNet, Granite, Mistral3, Qwen, and Gemma. This proves converter-source presence only, not runtime implementation, conversion success, quantization quality, or runtime fidelity.
SmolLM3 has an explicitly observed llama.cpp runtime source path at src/models/smollm3.cpp; even this source presence is not exact-candidate runtime qualification.
Unsloth pinned source contains direct family code/evidence for Falcon-H1, Granite, LFM2, and Qwen3.5-era paths, but source presence is not exact-candidate training qualification.

PEFT pinned main explicitly documents silent partial target-module skip risk on hybrid architectures; B009 therefore requires exact module-coverage auditing for Falcon-H1/LFM2-style hybrid candidates and explicit component-scope auditing for mixed-component Ministral training.
TRL is treated as a generic trainer layer only when the underlying Transformers/model path is valid; B009 does not infer candidate-specific trainability from TRL presence.

LiquidAI/LFM2.5-2.6B-Base is identity-blocked in B009 because only the B005 short revision c57bdae is available in the canonical input; B009 does not promote that short value into an immutable revision identity.
No GGUF conversion, quantization, tokenizer export, adapter training, or model inference was executed.
